text: Assignment four. SCP-682. They call it... the Hard to Destroy Reptile.
It lives in a steel chamber. Five meters across. Filled with acid... so it can't move.
They've shot it. Burned it. Dissolved it. It just... grows back.
And it hates everything that's alive. Everything.
Today they drain the acid for an interview. My job? Hold the microphone.
The doctor asks it why it killed those farmers. It says nothing.
Then it whispers. Too quiet. Move the mic closer, he tells me.
So I step closer. Its throat is torn open. It shouldn't be able to talk.
Its eye opens. And it looks right at me.
The alarms go off. The doctor is already running.
And I'm still holding the microphone.
